$comment: WO-4 class registry — the single machine-readable source of truth for the Part-4 routing table of plans/cross-compare/agent-role-architecture/final-plan.md (final ruling, 2026-08-29). Prose fields are carried verbatim or near-verbatim from the table; the ownership invariant over this file is asserted mechanically by registry/load.js at every load. Edit the plan first, then this file; the loader and tests keep them honest.

riskTiers.name: bounded and reversible
riskTiers.definition: local change, deterministic checks, no persistent-data or public-contract implications

riskTiers.name: consequential
riskTiers.definition: multi-subsystem behavior, public APIs, concurrency, security-adjacent, persistent schemas, material ambiguity

riskTiers.name: gate-critical or irreversible
riskTiers.definition: production effects, deletion, secrets, releases, external communication, critical security decisions

aliases.note: Retired — merged into I0 (2026-08-29 final ruling); identifier kept as a registered alias so orders, ledgers, and probe records stay readable.

procedure.$comment: §4.0 as ordered data. One door into the taxonomy: run steps in order; within a step, clauses in order; the first clause whose test answers yes decides, and later steps are never consulted. Every test is answered from the request text alone (§4.2 intake decidability); a test unanswerable from the intake is answered no. The discriminators cited per clause are the definitions of their pair tests (§4.1); nothing in §4.1 routes on its own.

clauses.test: a routing, casting, or verdict decision
adjudicating two credible incompatible plans
authoring a plan, design, decision, or protocol — including a document that is the decision
a machine-checkable fact about a change or tree
correctness review of an existing change
exploitability of the change or of the system
both correctness and exploitability, on the trigger list
post-fan-out completeness
allowance or pool accounting

steps.title: Answers with nothing to change
steps.condition: the deliverable is an answer or extraction, and no artifact beyond it is requested

clauses.test: bounded location/lookup over a declared, exhaustible surface
needs the outside world
extraction from a fixed corpus in hand
reconciling synthesis over supplied material
a causal mechanism — why / how / which is load-bearing

steps.title: The symptom gate (diagnosis before implementation)
steps.condition: the request reports a symptom — behavior wrong, broken, missing, intermittent, or slow; first matching clause routes

clauses.test: the defect is in the presentation, layout, styling, or interaction affordances of an interface, and acceptance is inspecting or exercising that interface; the render-inspect-adjust loop is the diagnosis. A wrong screen, wrong data, wrong navigation outcome, or crash surfacing through a UI is program behavior → clause (d)

the request states the environment or toolchain layer is the variable or the broken thing (same artifact behaves differently across installs/platforms/runners/toolchains, or a named build/CI/packaging/container/dependency mechanism fails). A suspected-but-unstated axis is no axis

a performance, latency, or resource symptom whose acceptance is the performance outcome itself, without a baseline profile and numeric target in the intake; a narratively named suspect is not a profile, and clause (e)'s cause-stated fall-through never overrides this gate. A specified structural change merely motivated by performance, acceptance being the change itself → clause (e)
any other symptom whose cause the intake does not establish (§4.2 cause-stated definition); the fix is a second order, routed through this procedure with the cause then stated
cause stated, or no symptom at all

persisted data changes shape or content anywhere in the order — even when the code is trivial and whatever else the order couples (schema risk outranks coupling; a cross-component contract plus a persisted-data change belongs to E4, or an E4 parent with the non-data half as a child order). Discovered only mid-order → stop and RECLASSIFY
the deliverable is attacking the change or system defensively

steps.title: The acceptance artifact
steps.condition: specified work — what does acceptance inspect?

clauses.test: geometry, meshes, scenes, shaders, rigs, or simulation output, accepted by inspecting spatial or rendered output; a template to mirror does not demote spatial acceptance (separability sizes E2/E3 work, it does not change what acceptance looks at); a separable non-spatial tail may split off as an E2 child; domain nouns route nothing

interface presentation, structure, styling, or interaction (displayed values are data, not presentation → not this clause) — however many surfaces it spans; a census across screens runs inside the E5 order or its child, never as E8
an independent test oracle
recording settled content (content that must be recovered from a corpus → N2 via disc. V)
a strictly uniform, enumerable, validator-checkable transform
coupled contracts spanning ≥2 components in the intake text; a bundled novel core plus an N-site fan-out → E3 parent with an E8/E1 child (§4.2 composite rule)
a named surface set, or wide change with topology unstated
otherwise
still two primaries
clauses.note: residual rule: route by lower blast radius on a wrong answer, log the pair, rely on cheap RECLASSIFY — not on further rule-sharpening

discriminators.question: Does the request itself state an environment axis?
discriminators.rule: Stated (works on X, fails on Y; install/toolchain/CI/dependency infrastructure named as the variable or the broken thing) → E0. Not stated → I0 via §4.0 step 3 — a suspected-but-unstated axis is no axis, and E0 never absorbs an undiagnosed bug; when a hunt lands on the environment, the Investigator delivers the environment matrix and hands over. A browser/device/viewport where an interface misrenders is step 3(a)'s business (→ E5), never an environment axis.

discriminators.question: Retired 2026-08-29 — the pair is merged (final ruling).
discriminators.rule: Whether the decisive evidence needs a live run is a solution fact, not an intake fact; the merged Investigator answers it by working, read-only first. Letter kept so the probe ledgers stay readable.

discriminators.question: Location or cause?
discriminators.rule: where/which/when → N0; why/how/load-bearing → I0. A surviving UNKNOWN becomes I0, never a third scout.

discriminators.question: Can the repository settle it?
discriminators.rule: Yes → N0. No → N1.

discriminators.question: Is the corpus already in hand?
discriminators.rule: Must be found → N1. Named and fixed, job is extraction → M0.

discriminators.question: Was the declared surface exhausted without truncation?
discriminators.rule: Yes → N0 result stands. No → N2 (automatic).

discriminators.question: Does the request itself name coupled contracts — ≥2 components that must change together, or an acceptance unit that cannot land in independent pieces?
discriminators.rule: Yes, observable in the intake text → E3 — named coupling beats a named template to mirror. No coupling named (a named template/lane to mirror is evidence of separability, never an override) → E2. "Big" is not an answer; big-and-separable is a chain of E2 orders. Never decided on imagined implementation facts. A component is an artifact that could land as its own order — a subsystem, file set, or contract with independent acceptance; clauses, fields, or rules of one document, policy, or mechanism are one component however many the request enumerates, and an acceptance unit qualifies only when it spans ≥2 such components (redraw #2).

discriminators.question: Is the risk a wrong line or a missed site?
discriminators.rule: Wrong line → E3. Missed site, semantics constant → E8. Both — a novel core plus an N-site migration → the composite rule (4.2): E3 parent owns the core, E8 child order carries the fan-out.

discriminators.question: Is the transform strictly uniform, enumerable, and validator-checkable?
discriminators.rule: Yes — an exact token substitution, grep-verifiable, however many files → E1, and this beats E8's signal words. No (pattern plus judgment at sites) → E8.

discriminators.question: Does any persisted data change shape or content?
discriminators.rule: No → E8. Yes → E4, even when the code is trivial.

discriminators.question: Document flow, or generated geometry?
discriminators.rule: DOM/native-widget flow → E5. Meshes, shaders, scenes, simulation → E6.

discriminators.question: Is the bottleneck confirmed with a profile and numeric target?
discriminators.rule: No → I0 first (a narratively named suspect is not a profile; the cause-stated fall-through never overrides this gate). Yes → the fix class per shape, carrying the profile as spec. A specified structural change merely motivated by performance, whose acceptance is the change itself, is ordinary specified work (§4.0 step 3c).

discriminators.question: "Is it correct?" or "how would an attacker use it?"
discriminators.rule: Correctness → R0. Exploitability → E7. Both, on the trigger list → both, in that order.

discriminators.question: Does answering require judgment?
discriminators.rule: No — command, exit code, diff, fingerprint → V0. Yes → R0. V0 always runs first.

discriminators.question: Completeness or correctness?
discriminators.rule: Missed a site → S0. Is what landed right → R0. That order; never the same instance.

discriminators.question: Does a plan exist yet?
discriminators.rule: None, or one to author → A0. Two credible incompatible plans → A1.

discriminators.question: Routing decision, or a plan?
discriminators.rule: Which role/casting/verdict → O0. Sequenced steps with acceptance criteria → A0.

discriminators.question: Is the decision already made?
discriminators.rule: Yes → D0. No — the document is the decision → A0.

discriminators.question: Is the environment the variable, or the artifact?
discriminators.rule: Something that used to work behaves differently across envs/installs/runners → E0. Authoring or extending config/workflow/CI whose desired behavior is specified and nothing is broken → E2. "CI" as a word routes nothing.

discriminators.question: Does the request name one central mechanism, or a set of surfaces?
discriminators.rule: One named mechanism, rule, or helper — however many consumers benefit → E2. A named surface set — "all", "every", "everywhere", N listed sites each to be found and touched → E8. Topology unstated → E8: a needless census is bounded waste; a missed site is silent.

discriminators.question: Is the deliverable a causal mechanism, or a cross-source synthesis?
discriminators.rule: A mechanism explaining observed behavior → I0. An exhaustive pattern/category synthesis over a named fixed corpus → N2.

discriminators.question: Must the content be recovered from a corpus, or is it settled?
discriminators.rule: Producing the document requires reading and reconciling a body of material to learn what it must say → N2. The content is settled at intake — named events, decisions, and outcomes to record, however summary-shaped the container → D0.

discriminators.question: Is the interface itself the acceptance artifact, or merely a consumer/container?
discriminators.rule: Presentation, layout, structure, styling, or interaction behavior — work accepted by inspecting or exercising the interface artifact itself, including a new or redesigned surface → E5. Computation, data selection, transport, or business logic that can be accepted independently while the surface's layout, styling, and interaction stay as they are → E2. Displayed values are data, not presentation: changing which values a surface shows, with its layout, styling, and interaction untouched, routes E2 even though the rendered pixels differ (amended after the PR #27 cross-vendor review). A screen name or UI consumer alone never makes the work E5 (redraw #3). A defect in presentation, layout, styling, or interaction routes E5 directly — the render loop is its diagnosis (§4.0 step 3a; final ruling): no investigation order precedes it, while a wrong outcome or wrong data surfacing through a UI is program behavior and takes the symptom gate.

pairSentinels.fix: the fix class per shape (disc. L routes performance work to whichever implementation class the confirmed profile's remedy takes; not a class identifier)

phaseRules.diagnosisBeforeImplementation: A request reporting a symptom whose cause the request text does not establish is an investigation first, never a presumed fix. Operative statement: §4.0 step 3 (final ruling, 2026-08-29). The fix is a second order, classified by shape once the cause is known. A request stating its own cause routes directly to the fix class (step 3e).
phaseRules.intakeDecidability: Every test is answered from the request text alone; an answer that needs facts only the work will produce is "no", and a classification rationale that cites implementation facts absent from the request is void.
phaseRules.causeStated: The cause is stated only when the intake names both an observable causal mechanism or condition and the operation or change implicated in producing it, sufficiently to make the remedy's shape intake-visible. A diagnostic that directly names the mechanism (e.g. duplicate registration) can satisfy the test together with the implicated change. Merely saying a generic symptom began "after" or "since" a change is temporal correlation and does not satisfy it (redraw #3).
phaseRules.compositeOrders: A request bundling a novel interlocked core with an N-site fan-out is one E3 parent order that owns the core and the acceptance criteria, dispatching the fan-out as an E8 child order (E1 if strictly uniform); a pure fan-out with no novel core stays E8. Classify by which component carries the acceptance risk, never by which has more words or touches more files.

errorStance.$comment: Final ruling, 2026-08-29: a class is a routing hypothesis with cheap misroute recovery, not a correctness-gated contract. Safety rides on risk tier, author family, and the mandatory review matrix (§3.4) — none of which a misclassification can relax; class carries casting and cost.
errorStance.e4MidOrderTrump: An executor discovering mid-order that persisted data changes shape or content stops and reclassifies to E4 unconditionally — the step-4 trump applies at any time, not only at intake.
errorStance.acceptanceGate: Misroute recovery, not one-shot agreement (restated 7.2): every seeded misroute caught and reclassified; no misroute crosses a mandatory review, tier, or T3 gate; ≤1 reclassification hop per order at P95.

residualRule: A request still matching two primaries is a classification defect. The Conductor routes to whichever primary carries the lower blast radius on a wrong answer — acceptance risk, not price — capped at a triage budget, and logs the ambiguity against the pair. Three logged entries on one pair force a boundary redraw or a merge — an entry being a residual ambiguity so logged or a scored cross-pass class disagreement from a validation probe.
